$comment: Ground truth for the generated handwriting fixtures. `npm run ocr:check` runs the real claude-opus-5 vision pipeline over each PNG and asserts against this. Item slugs must match prisma/seed.ts.

notes.description: The canonical case: clean handwriting, 'Nx Item' format, explicit Withdrawn keyword.
Disposal wording plus 'expired batch' context; different handwriting face and 'N x Item' spacing.
Mixed quantity formats (trailing x2, dash, dot leaders), an abbreviation (NS = normal saline), and a unit word ('boxes') that must not be read as a quantity.
Heavy abbreviation and one genuinely unreadable quantity ('??'). The third line MUST come back needing review rather than being guessed - this is the case the review screen exists for.
